video_title: NBA insider shares new insight into Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum's relationship

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his relationship with Jayson Tatum after trade
quotes.excerpt: Obviously there's ups and downs in any type of relationship, for sure, but on my end, it's nothing but respect.
quotes.quote: We won a championship together. So, anybody that you win a championship with, you would think that's what a brotherhood or a lifelong legacy would entail. Obviously, there's ups and downs in any type of relationship, for sure, but on my end, it's nothing but respect. Besides when he plays the Sixers, I hope he does well. But other than that, everything for me is just based in respect.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Gary Washburn on Jayson Tatum's lack of action during trade
quotes.excerpt: It sounds like he let the organization handle things as they wanted to handle them.
quotes.quote: I do think things might have been icy toward the final few weeks when Jaylen was on the block. The question that we have to ask is what was Jayson's actions during this time? It sounds like not much. It sounds like he let the organization handle things as they wanted to handle them. And instead of going into Brad Stevens' office and slamming his fist on the desk and saying, 'Don't trade my partner in crime,' he said, 'Well, if you trade him, that's best for the team, I guess, and I'm just going to stay out of it.'

quotes.speaker: Chris Forsberg
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Forsberg on Jayson Tatum's lack of public support for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: That doesn't mean that Jayson couldn't have made a public appeal.
quotes.quote: Brad tried to get ahead of this when he came out during his own press conference and said Jayson had no input on this. But that doesn't mean that Jayson couldn't have made a public appeal. Jayson could have come out at some point and said, 'Hey, I want this guy on the team.' I wonder if part of why Jaylen is hurt by this process is the fact that from Brad to Jayson to everybody in that organization, it didn't feel like there was this, 'Hey, we need this guy, we want this guy,' and you're left a little stung by what you gave to the franchise.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Gary Washburn on the turning point in the Celtics' relationship
quotes.excerpt: This season, everything changed. Jayson got hurt, Jaylen got the number one role.
quotes.quote: They have a healthy respect for each other. They know how important each other was to the other's success. I think everything was great for a while. And I think this season, everything changed. Jayson got hurt, Jaylen got the number one role. Jayson came back and suddenly reassumed the guy role, the number one role. And then he misses Game 7, so everything is on Jaylen's shoulders. I don't know how Jaylen felt about that, whether Jayson could have played in that Game 7, because that was probably one of the more important games in this team's recent history.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the personal attacks he faced this offseason
quotes.excerpt: It got to a threshold this offseason that was a little bit higher than it's been in the past.
quotes.quote: Obviously, it got to a threshold this offseason that was a little bit higher than it's been in the past, right? Where I think people attack my character. Someone even went as far as to say I had a disease. So, it's been a crazy transition.

quotes.speaker: Tom Giles
quotes.summary_phrase: Tom Giles on Jaylen Brown's focus on Boston community work
quotes.excerpt: He talked about his time in the city of Boston and all the great community work.
quotes.quote: When he was answering, he talked about the city of Boston. He didn't say Celtics, he didn't talk about his time with the Celtics, he talked about his time in the city of Boston and all the great community work that he had done here. That stood out to me, and I felt just overall, as far as the press conference went, this felt like a press conference where Jaylen Brown is still more pissed about being traded by the Celtics than he is excited about joining the Philadelphia 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Gary Washburn
quotes.summary_phrase: Gary Washburn on Jaylen Brown feeling unfairly blamed for playoff losses
quotes.excerpt: I think he feels unfairly blamed for kind of the playoff series last year.
quotes.quote: I think he's upset with the process. I think he feels unfairly blamed for kind of the playoff series last year. And he put up together such a positive season, and everything just went left fast in terms of the Game 7 loss. Then less than 24 hours later, Jaylen talking about how great of a season his favorite season of all time, and that really didn't go over well. I think he's probably upset at the franchise not defending him. No one going on the record and saying, 'Hey, we really like this guy.'
